entries.zh: 水平扩展（动词短语，副词 h 开头）

examples.en: The API tier is stateless, so we can scale horizontally by adding more instances.
examples.zh: API 层是无状态的，所以加实例就能水平扩展。

examples.en: We chose to scale horizontally because it was cheaper than buying one huge machine.
examples.zh: 我们选择水平扩展，因为这比买一台超大的机器便宜。

situation.zh: 面试官问：流量翻十倍，你的应用层怎么扛？
situation.en: I'd scale horizontally: put more instances behind the load balancer instead of making each one bigger.

entries.note: 也说 scale out；名词是 horizontal scaling。

entries.zh: 垂直扩展（动词短语，副词 v 开头）

examples.en: We scaled vertically for a while, but eventually we hit the limit of a single machine.
examples.zh: 我们靠升配置撑了一阵子，但最后还是碰到了单机的上限。

situation.zh: 面试官问：数据库写入快扛不住了，最省事的第一步是什么？
situation.en: The quickest fix is to scale vertically, meaning a bigger machine, but that only buys us time.

entries.note: 也说 scale up。注意区别：scale up 是升配置，scale out 是加机器。

examples.en: We moved session data into Redis, so it's now a stateless service and any instance can handle any request.
examples.zh: 我们把会话数据挪到了 Redis，现在它是无状态服务，任何实例都能处理任何请求。

situation.zh: 面试官问：为什么你们的服务可以随便加减实例？
situation.en: Because it's a stateless service. All the state lives in the database and the cache, not in the process.

entries.note: 反义是 stateful service。常见说法：keep the service stateless。

examples.en: We put a load balancer in front of the app servers to spread traffic evenly.
examples.zh: 我们在应用服务器前面放了一个负载均衡器，把流量均匀分摊开。

examples.en: The load balancer takes unhealthy instances out of rotation automatically.
examples.zh: 负载均衡器会自动把不健康的实例摘掉。

situation.zh: 面试官问：多个实例之间，请求是怎么分配的？
situation.en: A load balancer sits in front of them and distributes requests using round robin.

collocations: put a load balancer in front of

examples.en: With auto-scaling in place, the fleet grows during the day and shrinks at night.
examples.zh: 有了自动扩缩容，机器数量白天自动涨上去，晚上再缩回来。

situation.zh: 同事问：大促那天要不要提前手动加机器？你觉得不用，系统会按 CPU 自己加。
situation.en: We don't need to. Auto-scaling kicks in when average CPU goes above 60 percent.

entries.note: 动词是 auto-scale。加实例说 scale out，减实例说 scale in。

examples.en: Batching the writes roughly doubled our throughput without adding any hardware.
examples.zh: 把写入攒成批之后，吞吐量差不多翻了一倍，一台机器都没加。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们做这次优化，最想提升的指标是什么？
situation.en: Throughput. We wanted each node to handle more requests per second at the same latency.

entries.note: throughput 是单位时间的处理量，latency 是单次请求的耗时，两者常一起说。

entries.zh: 每秒查询数（三字母缩写）

examples.en: The search service peaks at around 20,000 QPS during the evening rush.
examples.zh: 搜索服务在晚高峰的峰值大约是两万 QPS。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个接口现在的请求量有多大？
situation.en: It handles about 5,000 QPS on average and peaks at roughly three times that.

entries.note: 逐字母读，全称 queries per second。国外更常说 requests per second（RPS）；写入量可以说 writes per second。

examples.en: Our median was fine, but the p99 latency was over two seconds.
examples.zh: 中位数没问题，但 99 分位延迟超过了两秒。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么衡量这个接口够不够快？
situation.en: We look at p99 latency rather than the average, because the average hides the slow requests.

entries.note: 读作 p ninety-nine，意思是 99% 的请求都比这个值快。也说 99th percentile latency；泛指长尾时说 tail latency。latency 读 /ˈleɪtənsi/。

examples.en: Profiling showed that the database was the bottleneck, not the application code.
examples.zh: 性能分析显示瓶颈在数据库，不在应用代码。

situation.zh: 面试官问：系统扛不住的时候，你第一步做什么？
situation.en: I'd find the bottleneck first, because scaling the wrong tier doesn't help.

examples.en: It's a read-heavy workload, roughly a hundred reads for every write, so caching pays off.
examples.zh: 这是读多写少的负载，读写比大约一百比一，所以加缓存很划算。

situation.zh: 面试官问：设计商品详情页之前，你怎么判断它的流量特点？
situation.en: I'd assume a read-heavy workload, since people browse far more often than they buy.

entries.note: 反过来是 write-heavy workload。读写比说 read-to-write ratio。

examples.en: On a cache miss, we load the row from the database and store it in Redis.
examples.zh: 缓存未命中时，我们从数据库读出这一行，再写进 Redis。

situation.zh: 面试官问：缓存重启之后，接口为什么会慢一阵？
situation.en: The cache is empty after a restart, so every request is a cache miss and hits the database.

entries.note: 反义是 cache hit，命中率是 cache hit ratio。cache 读 /kæʃ/，和 cash 同音。

examples.en: We use cache-aside: the app checks the cache first and falls back to the database.
examples.zh: 我们用旁路缓存：应用先查缓存，没有再回源到数据库。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们的缓存是怎么读写的？
situation.en: We use the cache-aside pattern. On a miss, the app loads from the database and populates the cache.

entries.note: 也叫 lazy loading。写的时候一般是先更新数据库，再删缓存。

entries.zh: 缓存失效（主动让缓存作废，名词）

examples.en: Cache invalidation was the hard part: we delete the key whenever the underlying row changes.
examples.zh: 缓存失效是最难的部分：底层那一行一变，我们就把对应的键删掉。

situation.zh: 面试官问：引入缓存之后，最容易出问题的地方是什么？
situation.en: Cache invalidation. If we forget to invalidate a key after an update, users see stale data.

entries.note: 动词是 invalidate。

examples.en: We set the eviction policy to LRU, so the least recently used keys go first.
examples.zh: 我们把淘汰策略设成了 LRU，最近最少使用的键最先被淘汰。

situation.zh: 面试官问：缓存内存满了会怎么样？
situation.en: It depends on the eviction policy. Ours evicts the least recently used keys to make room.

entries.note: 动词是 evict。常见策略：LRU（least recently used）、LFU（least frequently used）。

entries.zh: 存活时间（缓存过期时间的三字母缩写）

examples.en: We set a five-minute TTL on the product cache so stale entries expire on their own.
examples.zh: 我们给商品缓存设了五分钟的过期时间，旧数据到点会自己失效。

situation.zh: 面试官问：如果某次更新忘了删缓存，怎么兜底？
situation.en: Every key has a TTL, so even in the worst case the data is only stale for a few minutes.

entries.note: 逐字母读，全称 time to live。

examples.en: A single node couldn't handle the write volume, so we introduced sharding by user ID.
examples.zh: 单个节点扛不住写入量，所以我们按用户 ID 做了分片。

situation.zh: 面试官问：单库的写入到上限了，加只读副本也帮不上忙，怎么办？
situation.en: At that point I'd consider sharding, so that writes are spread across multiple databases.

entries.note: 动词是 shard，一个分片叫 a shard。更通用的说法是 partitioning。

examples.en: We picked the tenant ID as the shard key so each tenant's data stays together.
examples.zh: 我们选租户 ID 作分片键，这样每个租户的数据都落在一起。

situation.zh: 面试官问：分库之后，怎么保证大部分查询只打到一个库？
situation.en: By choosing the right shard key. Most of our queries filter by user ID, so that's what we shard on.

entries.note: 也说 partition key。选得不好会导致数据倾斜和跨分片查询。

examples.en: One celebrity account created a hot partition that took most of the write traffic.
examples.zh: 一个明星账号造成了热点分区，大部分写流量都压在它上面。

situation.zh: 面试官问：按用户 ID 分片有什么隐患？
situation.en: A few very active users can create a hot partition, so one node is overloaded while the rest sit idle.

entries.note: 也说 hotspot、hot shard；单个键过热叫 hot key。数据分布不均叫 skew。

examples.en: With consistent hashing, adding a node only moves a small fraction of the keys.
examples.zh: 用一致性哈希的话，加一个节点只需要迁移一小部分键。

situation.zh: 面试官问：缓存集群加一台机器，怎么避免大部分键都要重新映射？
situation.en: I'd use consistent hashing, so only the keys next to the new node on the ring get remapped.

entries.zh: 再均衡（动词，重新分配各节点上的数据）

examples.en: After adding two nodes, the cluster took about an hour to rebalance.
examples.zh: 加了两个节点之后，集群花了大约一个小时做再均衡。

situation.zh: 面试官问：集群扩容之后，旧节点上的数据怎么办？
situation.en: The cluster has to rebalance, which means moving some partitions onto the new nodes.

entries.note: 及物、不及物都行：rebalance the partitions / the cluster rebalances。名词是 rebalancing。

entries.zh: 主从复制（用“领导者、跟随者”那套说法）

examples.en: We run leader-follower replication: all writes go to the leader and followers serve reads.
examples.zh: 我们用的是主从复制：写全部走主库，读由从库承担。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们的数据库是怎么做复制的？
situation.en: We use leader-follower replication, with one leader taking writes and two followers replicating from it.

entries.note: 也说 primary-replica replication。旧说法 master-slave 很多团队已经不用了，面试里避开。

examples.en: We added two read replicas to take reporting queries off the primary.
examples.zh: 我们加了两个只读副本，把报表查询从主库上挪走。

situation.zh: 面试官问：读流量快把主库压垮了，但写入不多，怎么扩？
situation.en: I'd add read replicas and route read-only queries to them.

entries.note: replica 重音在第一个音节：/ˈreplɪkə/。

examples.en: Replication lag spiked to thirty seconds, so users couldn't see their own updates.
examples.zh: 复制延迟飙到了三十秒，用户看不到自己刚改的内容。

situation.zh: 同事问：用户刚改完头像，刷新后还是旧的，为什么？
situation.en: That read went to a replica, and replication lag means the replica hasn't caught up yet.

examples.en: We use synchronous replication for payments, so a confirmed write survives losing the leader.
examples.zh: 支付这块我们用同步复制，所以主库挂了，已确认的写入也不会丢。

situation.zh: 面试官问：主库突然宕机，怎么保证已经返回成功的写入不丢？
situation.en: With synchronous replication, the leader waits for a follower to confirm before it acknowledges the write.

entries.note: 代价是写延迟变高。反义是 asynchronous replication，折中方案叫 semi-synchronous。

entries.zh: 副本因子（每份数据存几份）

examples.en: We run with a replication factor of three, so we can lose a node safely.
examples.zh: 我们的副本因子是三，所以挂掉一个节点也没事。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个集群里每份数据存了几份？
situation.en: We use a replication factor of three, with each copy in a different availability zone.

examples.en: Account balances need strong consistency, so we always read them from the primary.
examples.zh: 账户余额需要强一致性，所以我们一律从主库读。

situation.zh: 面试官问：库存扣减可以接受读到旧数据吗？
situation.en: No. Inventory needs strong consistency, otherwise we could oversell.

entries.note: 形容词说法是 strongly consistent。

examples.en: We accepted eventual consistency for the like counter because nobody notices a short delay.
examples.zh: 点赞数我们接受最终一致性，因为短暂的延迟没人会注意到。

situation.zh: 面试官问：动态的点赞数在各个地区必须实时一致吗？
situation.en: No, eventual consistency is fine there. The replicas converge within a second or two.

entries.note: 形容词说法是 eventually consistent。eventual 读 /ɪˈventʃuəl/。

examples.en: To get read-your-writes consistency, we route a user's reads to the leader right after they write.
examples.zh: 为了做到读己之写一致性，用户刚写完的那段时间，我们把他的读请求路由到主库。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户发完评论马上刷新却看不到，你怎么解决？
situation.en: That's a read-your-writes consistency problem. I'd read from the leader for a few seconds after the user posts.

entries.note: 也说 read-after-write consistency。只保证用户能看到自己的写入，不保证看到别人的。

examples.en: The CAP theorem says that during a network partition we have to pick consistency or availability.
examples.zh: CAP 定理说的是：发生网络分区时，一致性和可用性只能选一个。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个存储为什么在网络故障时宁可拒绝写入？
situation.en: Because of the CAP theorem. It's a CP system, so during a partition it gives up availability to stay consistent.

entries.note: CAP 当一个词读 /kæp/。常说某个系统是 CP 或 AP。别说成“三选二”：分区避免不了，实际是在 C 和 A 之间选。

entries.zh: 过期读（读到了旧数据，名词短语）

examples.en: Reading from a replica is faster, but we might get a stale read.
examples.zh: 从副本读更快，但可能会读到旧数据。

situation.zh: 面试官问：读请求走从库有什么代价？
situation.en: The risk is a stale read: the replica may be slightly behind the leader.

entries.note: stale 也可以直接修饰数据。别和 dirty read（脏读，读到未提交的数据）混淆。

examples.en: We put a message queue between the API and the workers so uploads return immediately.
examples.zh: 我们在 API 和 worker 之间加了一个消息队列，这样上传请求可以立刻返回。

situation.zh: 面试官问：发邮件很慢，怎么不让它拖住下单接口？
situation.en: I'd publish an event to a message queue and let a background worker send the email.

entries.note: queue 读 /kjuː/，和字母 Q 同音。入队是 enqueue，出队是 dequeue。
collocations: put a message on the queue

examples.en: We switched to pub/sub so that new services can subscribe without changing the publisher.
examples.zh: 我们改成了发布订阅，这样新服务直接订阅就行，不用改发布方。

situation.zh: 面试官问：订单创建后有五个下游都要知道，怎么通知？
situation.en: I'd use pub/sub: the order service publishes one event to a topic and each downstream service subscribes to it.

entries.note: 读 /ˈpʌb sʌb/，全称 publish-subscribe。
collocations: publish an event to a topic

examples.en: We added more instances to the consumer group to process the partitions in parallel.
examples.zh: 我们往消费者组里加了几个实例，好并行处理各个分区。

situation.zh: 面试官问：怎么让多个实例分摊同一个主题的消息，又不重复处理？
situation.en: Put them in the same consumer group, so each partition is assigned to only one of them.

entries.note: Kafka 的概念：同组内一个分区只分给一个消费者；不同的组各自收到全量消息。

entries.zh: 消息代理（负责收发和存储消息的中间件）

examples.en: We chose Kafka as our message broker because we needed to replay events.
examples.zh: 我们选 Kafka 做消息中间件，因为我们需要重放事件。

situation.zh: 面试官问：服务之间的异步消息，你们靠什么来转发？
situation.en: Everything goes through a message broker. We use RabbitMQ for task queues and Kafka for event streams.

entries.note: 常简称 the broker。发消息的一方是 producer，收消息的一方是 consumer。

examples.en: The queue decouples the order service from the email service, so one can fail without the other.
examples.zh: 队列把订单服务和邮件服务解耦了，一个挂了不会连累另一个。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这两个服务为什么不直接同步调用？
situation.en: We wanted to decouple them, so a slow consumer never blocks the producer.

entries.note: 搭配是 decouple A from B。形容词：loosely coupled（松耦合）、tightly coupled（紧耦合）。

examples.en: The broker guarantees at-least-once delivery, so our handlers have to tolerate duplicates.
examples.zh: 消息中间件保证的是至少一次投递，所以我们的处理逻辑必须能容忍重复消息。

situation.zh: 面试官问：消费者处理到一半崩了，这条消息会丢吗？
situation.en: No. We rely on at-least-once delivery, so the message is redelivered, but we may see it twice.

entries.note: 对应的还有 at-most-once delivery（最多一次：可能丢，但不会重复）。

examples.en: True exactly-once delivery is very hard, so we combine at-least-once with idempotent consumers.
examples.zh: 真正的恰好一次投递很难做到，所以我们用至少一次投递加幂等消费者来实现。

situation.zh: 面试官问：扣款消息能保证只被处理一次吗？
situation.en: We don't rely on exactly-once delivery. We deduplicate on the consumer side, so the effect is exactly once.

entries.note: 更严谨的说法是 exactly-once semantics 或 effectively-once：消息可能重复送达，但处理效果只生效一次。

examples.en: After five failed attempts, the message goes to a dead-letter queue for manual inspection.
examples.zh: 失败五次之后，消息会进死信队列，等人工排查。

situation.zh: 面试官问：有一条消息怎么处理都报错，会不会一直卡住后面的消息？
situation.en: No. After a few attempts we move it to a dead-letter queue and carry on with the rest.

entries.note: 缩写 DLQ。那种怎么处理都失败的消息叫 poison message。

entries.zh: 确认（消息已处理），a 开头的动词

examples.en: The consumer only acknowledges a message after the database write has committed.
examples.zh: 消费者要等数据库写入提交之后才确认这条消息。

situation.zh: 面试官问：怎么保证消费者崩溃时消息不丢？
situation.en: The consumer acknowledges a message only after processing it, so an unacknowledged message gets redelivered.

entries.note: 口语和代码里常缩成 ack：ack a message。名词是 acknowledgment。

examples.en: Events can arrive out of order, so we attach a version number to each one.
examples.zh: 事件可能乱序到达，所以我们给每个事件带上版本号。

situation.zh: 面试官问：同一个订单的“已创建”和“已支付”两条消息，到达顺序反了怎么办？
situation.en: Messages can arrive out of order across partitions, so I'd use the order ID as the partition key.

entries.note: 作定语时加连字符：out-of-order events。保证顺序说 preserve ordering，顺序保证是 ordering guarantee。

examples.en: We made the payment endpoint idempotent, so retrying a request never charges the customer twice.
examples.zh: 我们把支付接口做成了幂等的，重试请求也不会重复扣款。

situation.zh: 面试官问：客户端超时后重发了同一个请求，会不会重复下单？
situation.en: No, the endpoint is idempotent. Sending the same request twice has the same effect as sending it once.

entries.note: 名词是 idempotency（也有人说 idempotence）。也有人把重音放在第二音节，两种读法都听得到。

examples.en: The client sends an idempotency key with each request, and we store it with the result.
examples.zh: 客户端每次请求都带一个幂等键，我们把它和处理结果一起存下来。

situation.zh: 面试官问：服务端怎么知道两个请求其实是同一次操作？
situation.en: The client generates an idempotency key, and if we've seen that key before we return the saved response.

examples.en: We deduplicate events by message ID before applying them to the ledger.
examples.zh: 我们先按消息 ID 对事件去重，再把它们记到账本里。

situation.zh: 面试官问：消息会重复投递，你在消费端怎么处理？
situation.en: We deduplicate on the consumer side by recording processed message IDs in a table with a unique constraint.

entries.note: 口语常缩成 dedupe，名词是 deduplication。
